title: Convergence-loop run record
description: The normalized record `loop_state.py run-record` emits at a terminal status (converged / suspended / hard_terminated). Aggregates the append-only event log + state into one machine-consumed artifact. The `l4_assessment` block is the instrumented form of the maturity.md rubric — a provisional verdict on whether this run evidences L4, pending human confirm. Every run record MUST conform; adding a field requires updating this schema AND infra/test/run_record_schema.py's validator if it uses a new keyword. Validated in infra/test/run_record.py.

blueprint_ref.description: Path to the frozen Intent Blueprint. Omitted when no blueprint.

outcome.description: Derived from final status. 'non-terminal' when run-record is emitted before a terminal mark-* (operator error, but the tool emits valid JSON rather than crashing).

dod_satisfied.description: True iff outcome=='converged' AND >=1 outer-ring review ran (ADR #16 Definition of Done). False exposes a converged-without-outer-ring state — which mark-converged refuses and this backstop reports honestly via outcome_met=false.

breakers_fired.description: Every non-ok breaker firing (from gate-fail / mark-* events) with its trigger.

outer_verdicts.description: Each outer-ring review verdict. One entry == one inner→outer context fold (context-rot defense evidence).

rollbacks.description: Each hard rollback (intent-drift → snapshot restore). Goal-drift defense evidence.

rightness.description: CONSTANT — the outcome axis (is the run's conclusion 'right') is out of the loop's scope. The enum has exactly ONE value to STRUCTURALLY enforce field isolation: no matter converged/dod_satisfied, rightness is always human_confirm_required. A consumer must never read a green process axis as outcome-axis success (paper §4.2).

upstream.description: Optional upstream-artifact provenance (rich path, odp2-verdict-design D1): when parallel-development consumes a blueprint-crafting artifact, it records bc's convergence verdict here as provenance — NOT a gate-skip (process_converged is necessary-but-not-sufficient; charter R6). Omitted on the free path.

process_converged.description: bc's process-axis verdict — a trust signal, not execution-correctness.

verdict.description: adversarial-stalemate = the different-family multi-round debate hit the round cap without convergence (ADR #40 (e)); never resolves by silently adopting either side — escalates to human.

lost_uc.description: The Core Use Case that was drifting; '' when unspecified.

task_descriptor.description: Human-declared DEMAND setup (novel codebase / fuzzy requirements / high difficulty / unattended) — a probe-grade run that stress-tests capacity. NOT a capacity criterion (capacity = 3-degradation defense, ADR #38). Omitted (top-level `task` absent) for non-probe runs; a non-probe run can still be l4-evidenced on capacity alone.

target_horizon_steps.description: DEMAND threshold — the step-count bar a probe run stress-tests capacity with (an estimate, not authoritative — per fedaot-wiki; NOT a capacity criterion, ADR #38).

l4_assessment.description: Provisional, computed verdict on whether this run evidences L4 — the instrumented form of references/maturity.md's rubric. Capacity/demand split (ADR #38): capacity = 3-degradation defense under convergence (the l4-evidenced gate); horizon + is_l4_probe are DEMAND (evidence weight, not the gate). Final judgment stays human (task novelty/difficulty are human-declared; this only rolls up the evidence). `terminal_cause` is provider-normalized: a resource cap (time/token/cost) is 'inconclusive' on capability, not a failure — wall-clock confounds provider throughput.

is_l4_probe.description: True iff task descriptor present AND novel AND fuzzy AND high AND unattended. DEMAND declaration (probe-grade run marker), NOT a capacity gate — a non-probe run can still be l4-evidenced (ADR #38).

terminal_cause.description: Why the run ended, provider-normalized. resource-capped = a budget axis (time/token/cost) hit -> inconclusive on capability; step-capped = total steps hit the provider-independent cap -> capability signal.

horizon_met.description: DEMAND marker (run-lifetime evidence weight), NOT a capacity criterion (ADR #38).

caveats_addressed.description: maturity.md caveats this run can retire. l4-evidenced AND is_l4_probe (probe-grade demand + capacity) → ['caveat-2-unproven-at-scale']; else [] (ADR #38: caveat-2 is demand-weighted — non-probe l4-evidenced has capacity but lacks probe-grade demand).

human_confirm_required.description: Always true — final L4 judgment is human.
